research_question: Can origin-observable intraday realized moments plus a completed-month BOCPD structural-break context improve selective quantile forecasts of medium-horizon gold returns without hindsight tuning?

source.gold_endpoint: XAU/USD exact 13:29 America/New_York research cache bar

realized_moment_session.return_clock: consecutive close-to-close one-minute log returns within the frozen same-day session only

source.bocpd_availability: a completed BOCPD month becomes observable on the first calendar day of the following month; current-month state is forbidden
source.external_daily_rule: inherits V1.55 strict previous-source-date rule for equities and precious metals
source.historical_reconstruction_warning: equity/precious daily histories and the intraday research cache are retrospective research reconstructions, not contemporaneously archived prospective PIT evidence

h1_policy: NOT_RESCORED_PRIMARY; V1.56 already established insufficient robust H1 evidence

break_aware_training.rule: at origin t use only mature rows on or after the latest origin-observable BOCPD map-reset availability date when at least 63 such rows exist; otherwise use the latest 126 mature rows

model.quantile_rearrangement: sort independently estimated q25/q50/q75 at each origin

direction_rule.selective: q25>0 => UP; q75<0 => DOWN; otherwise NO_SIGNAL

evaluation.overlap_adjustment: HAC/Newey-West style loss-differential variance with lag h-1; report HLN-adjusted Diebold-Mariano diagnostic where defined

primary_support_rule.inferential_rule: DM/HAC and PT p-values are diagnostics under overlapping horizons and researcher-visible periods; no isolated p-value promotes a model

evaluation.data_snooping_warning: V1.51 through V1.57 reused the same historical outcomes for successor research; White Reality Check/Hansen SPA is required before thesis claims of specification-search superiority
